caption: The drawing depicts components of a man’s formal suit on a gray background with an off-white border. At the center, there is a detailed illustration of a double-breasted tailcoat and matching high-waisted trousers in a light cream or white color, including visible stitch lines and buttons. To the left, there is a line drawing of the back view of the tailcoat, showing seam and pleat details at the waist. On the right, there are two separate line drawings of trousers, one displaying a side profile and the other a back view, both highlighting pocket and seam placement. Beneath these, there is a smaller drawing of a flap pocket, also marked with visible stitching and button placement. The entire composition uses shades of gray, cream, and white, with the garment details in finer, darker lines to distinguish construction elements.
title: Sugar Merchant's Suit
